In Apache Spark we have two features that are crucial for query optimization:

- *Projection Pushdown:* It allows the query to select only the desiderd columns;
- *Predicate Pushdown:* It allows the query to make filter operation before any other;

Novelty and Outlier Detection:

- *Outlier Detection:* Observation that are far from other in the training set
- *Novelty Detection:* It detects whether a new observation is an outlier
